jobs.description:
As a Cleaning Operator, you will work in a high-tech production environment in Eindhoven, where industrial packaging and transport boxes are cleaned, inspected, and prepared for reuse. This is a full-time position in a 2-shift schedule within an international organization with long-term career opportunities.

Function Description

As a Cleaning Operator, you are responsible for cleaning and preparing high-tech packaging materials according to strict quality standards and work instructions. You play an important role in ensuring that industrial packaging is ready for safe worldwide transport.

Your daily responsibilities include:

- Cleaning industrial packaging and transport boxes according to work instructions.
- Removing labels, contamination, and transport damage from packaging.
- Cleaning and packing packaging materials and components.
- Working according to cleanroom and logistics procedures.
- Reading English checklists and technical work instructions.
- Reporting quality deviations and process irregularities.
- Operating an EPT (Electric Pallet Truck) or stacker.

You will work in a 2-shift schedule:

- Week 1: Monday to Friday, 06:00 – 15:00
- Week 2: Monday to Friday, 15:00 – 00:00

You will receive an 18% shift allowance, which is included in the stated monthly salary.

Saturday work may occasionally be required in consultation. Hours worked on Saturdays are paid with a 50% allowance on top of your regular hourly wage.

Must-haves

- Willingness to work in a 2-shift schedule.
- Ability to read technical drawings and work instructions.
- Good command of the Dutch and/or English language.
- Affinity with cleaning and production work.
- Willingness to work occasional Saturdays when required.

Nice to have

- Experience as an assembly worker, production worker, or logistics employee.
- Experience operating an EPT or stacker.
- Living in or within easy travelling distance of Eindhoven, Helmond, Veldhoven, Veghel, or Valkenswaard.

- Load and unload trucks
- Check and process incoming goods
- Pack and prepare outgoing shipments
- Store products in the correct warehouse locations
- Assist with inventory counts and stock management
- Maintain a clean and safe working environment

- You speak Dutch or English
- You can travel independently to Helmond
- You are physically fit and enjoy active work
- You are available for day shifts from 08:00 AM to 04:30 PM

jobs.description:
As a logistics employee at Samsung SDS in Breda, you will help get products from Samsung and other companies to the right place. You work in a team where there are regular staff meetings to get to know each other better.

Your tasks depend on the position. Primarily your tasks will be physical, so you need to be physicaly fit. You might be packing and preparing products like microwaves and tv's for shipment. Or you might be loading and unloading containers either with forklift or manually.

You will work two shifts: early (6 a.m. to 3.00 p.m.) or late (3.00 p.m. to 0.00 p.m.).

You will work between 30 and 40 hours per week. 

Do you want to contribute to Samsung's success? Then apply now!

You enjoy working in an international environment and love to work hard. At Samsung SDS, you'll help keep everything running smoothly in the warehouse.

What you bring:

- You have your own transportation to get to work. When you work in shifts, public transport is not possible
- You speak good English, which is helpful in this international environment.
- You are available full-time
- You are fit enough for physical work.
- You have your own accommodation.

It is nice if you are flexible. Sometimes we work overtime or on weekends. But don't worry, that doesn't happen every week!

Working hours

- Minimum of 1 year experience in cleanroom, production, or assembly work

Preferred

Get started in logistics at a growing DHL location

Do you like to roll up your sleeves and start working quickly? At our new DHL Supply Chain location in Bemmel, we are looking for warehouse employees.

This is a site that is still developing: new clients are regularly being onboarded, so no two days are the same and you will continuously learn new tasks.

What will you do?

- Picking orders using a scanning system
- Checking and replenishing products
- Packing orders and preparing them for shipment
- Processing incoming and outgoing goods
- Supporting various processes depending on the client
- Ensuring a clean and safe working environment

Good to know: working hours

In July, August, and September, we operate in three shifts to handle the busy period:

- 06:00 – 15:00
- 08:00 – 17:00
- 15:00 – 24:00

From October onwards, you will switch to regular day shifts (Monday to Friday between 07:00 and 18:00). Your weekends will be free.
